# memecoin-markets (Blockchain Lab)

> Free memecoin safety and trading-desk toolkit for memecoin.markets / memecoin.grok.me. Zero-dependency browser+Node SDK, read-only MCP server, static JSON API and a GitHub Pages app. Real public data (DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, RugCheck, GoPlus, honeypot.is, Jupiter, Solana/EVM public RPCs). Evidence, not advice; never signs or trades.

## Endpoints (CORS *)
- https://blockchains.github.io/memecoin-markets/v1/index.json — endpoint list
- https://blockchains.github.io/memecoin-markets/v1/radar-solana.json — newest Solana pools + DexScreener boosts/profiles with flags
- https://blockchains.github.io/memecoin-markets/v1/radar-base.json — same for Base
- https://blockchains.github.io/memecoin-markets/v1/scans-solana.json — full safety scans keyed by mint (latest boosts + fresh liquid pools)
- https://blockchains.github.io/memecoin-markets/v1/policy.json — policy-v1.1 thresholds + launch checklist
- https://blockchains.github.io/memecoin-markets/lib/index.js — SDK as an ES module

## SDK
- scanToken({address, chain?}) -> verdict FAIL | INCOMPLETE | DESK_PASS | CLEAR + per-check evidence
- radar({chain, limit, rugcheck}) -> newest pairs with quick flags
- ukCgt(trades) -> HMRC same-day / 30-day / Section 104 matching per UK tax year; fifoPnl(trades); toRotkiCsv(trades)
- evaluateChecklist(scan) -> launch checklist; valuePortfolio(holdings,{gbp}); walletHoldings(owner,{rpc})

## MCP
- npx -y github:Blockchains/memecoin-markets memecoin-mcp — tools: memecoin_scan_token, memecoin_new_pairs, memecoin_launch_checklist, memecoin_jupiter_quote, memecoin_uk_cgt, memecoin_fifo_pnl, memecoin_rotki_csv, memecoin_portfolio
